layouts.name: Drakon
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator Time Attack circuit plan identifies the earlier Kaloyanovo layout with the northern rectangular return, long diagonal straight and southern parallel hairpin. The 2024 independent closed raceway matches this branch sequence and measures 1991.8 m, close to the 1998 m catalogue scalar. The 2026 mapped extension measures about 2.89 km and is not substituted for this earlier configuration. Pit and service routes are excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1991.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
